Definition: Bukki, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bukki = "wasting"; 1) son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests; 2) son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes
